changes.from: Two questions. (1) iOS: without Full Access the keyboard cannot read settings made in the Tatakikun app. Should the language switches (a) be inside the keyboard itself (for example a long press on 🌐 opens them), or (b) be in the app, which needs Full Access turned on (iOS then asks users to 'Allow Full Access' with a privacy warning; same choice as the iPad Ctrl key in A04-cell054)? (2) macOS, from the task: should the settings also install and remove packs (download), or only turn installed ones on and off (done now, in the input menu)?
